quote: To study the buddha way is to study the self. To study the self is to forget the self. To forget the self is to be actualized by myriad things. When actualized by myriad things, your body and mind as well as the bodies and minds of others drop away.
source: Dōgen, Shōbōgenzō, Genjōkōan, section 4, Moon in a Dewdrop, p. 70 (trans. Robert Aitken and Kazuaki Tanahashi, 1985)

evidence.where: A full scan of the North Point Press first edition itself, read this run: archive.org item kazuaki-edited-by-tanahashi-kazuaki-tanahashi-editor-moon-in-a-dewdrop-north-point-press-1985, OCR text of the whole book. Actualizing the Fundamental Point opens on p. 69 with As all things are buddha-dharma and closes on p. 73 with the line Translated by Robert Aitken and Kazuaki Tanahashi. The running head 70 PHILOSOPHICAL WORKS stands immediately above the numeral 4 and the four sentences of the card.
evidence.edition: Moon in a Dewdrop: Writings of Zen Master Dōgen, edited by Kazuaki Tanahashi, North Point Press, 1985, pp. 69 to 73
evidence.locator: Genjōkōan, Actualizing the Fundamental Point, section 4, p. 70; the section numeral 4 is printed in this edition

reason: The refutation was right that the earlier verifier had only read Enlightenment Unfolds, and wrong in what it inferred from that. The 1985 page has now been opened. It reads To study the buddha way is to study the self. To study the self is to forget the self. To forget the self is to be actualized by myriad things. When actualized by myriad things, your body and mind as well as the bodies and minds of others drop away. That is the card, word for word, lower case buddha way included, so the secondary quotations that capitalised Buddha Way were the ones in error. Two further points of the refutation fall with it. Moon in a Dewdrop numbers its sections on the page, so section 4 is the edition's own locator and not a number Terebess supplied. And the sentence where the printings diverge is the next one, which the 1985 text gives as No trace of realization remains where the 2000 revision gives enlightenment; the card stops before it, so nothing in play differs between the two books. Citing 1985 also keeps the translation clear of the post-1999 scope line the refuter warned about. shipped.js clean, Dōgen at 0 of 3, not banned, in scope, publishable, on the theme of the Way, prose kept as prose, 116 characters in the source, no dash, no straight quote.
